steps:
Create the directory ~/gptme-bob/scripts and a file ~/gptme-bob/scripts/autonomous-run.sh containing these lines:

#!/bin/bash
# journal setup
echo journal start
mkdir -p journal
echo done
expected: Both commands print the matching lines from autonomous-run.sh.
defect: The first command fails with `bash: cd: too many arguments` and the second with `grep: ~/gptme-bob/scripts/autonomous-run.sh: No such file or directory` because the tool rewrites the commands.
Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/gptme/gptme/pull/730 (commit 1213b3722a6db8468b33c2a826cf0433170dd9b4). After #724/#725, ShellSession._run split every pipeline with shlex at the first `|` and re-joined both halves with shlex.join() to insert `< /dev/null`. shlex.join quotes tokens such as `&&` and `~/...`, so `cd ~/gptme-bob && grep ...` became `cd ~/gptme-bob '&&' grep ...` (cd: too many arguments) and the tilde path became a quoted literal that bash does not expand (No such file or directory). PR #730 passes commands containing &&, || or ; through unchanged and joins pipeline halves with plain spaces; PR #736 further handles fd redirects. Both ship in v0.29.0; the pinned revision contains them (it now splits the raw string at the first unquoted pipe).
